records.source: A tabular model (HistGradientBoosting or XGBoost on the DNA and microtubule features of :func:`spacr.ops_mitotic.mitotic_features`, each a robust z against all cells of its well) calls interphase, g2_prophase (a flag class, never counted as mitotic), prometaphase, metaphase, ana_telo_cyto (anaphase and telophase/cytokinesis), telophase_daughters (the two 2N daughters, a stage of their own) and artefact. Interphase cells take G1, S or G2 from the field-centred DNA-content fit of item 995 (:func:`_dna_phases`). Self-checks S1-S6 run on every plate; a stage that fails its check collapses into its parent (:data:`PARENTS`) and is flagged ``unresolved``, on every plate of the screen once any plate collapses it. A stage whose out-of-fold F1 on the user's labels clears the shuffled-label control is ``verified``; every other stage is ``auto``.
records.context: A tabular model (HistGradientBoosting or XGBoost on the DNA and microtubule features of :func:`spacr.ops_mitotic.mitotic_features`, each a robust z against all cells of its well) calls interphase, g2_prophase (a flag class, never counted as mitotic), prometaphase, metaphase, ana_telo_cyto (anaphase and telophase/cytokinesis), telophase_daughters (the two 2N daughters, a stage of their own) and artefact. Interphase cells take G1, S or G2 from the microscope field of view-centred DNA-content fit of item 995 (:func:`_dna_phases`). Self-checks S1-S6 run on every laboratory microplate; a stage that fails its check collapses into its parent (:data:`PARENTS`) and is flagged ``unresolved``, on every laboratory microplate of the screen once any laboratory microplate collapses it. A stage whose out-of-fold F1 on the user's labels clears the shuffled-label control is ``verified``; every other stage is ``auto``.
records.translation: Um modelo tabular (HistGradientBoosting ou XGBoost sobre as características de DNA e microtúbulos de :func:`spacr.ops_mitotic.mitotic_features`, cada uma expressa como uma pontuação z robusta em relação a todas as células do seu poço) atribui interphase, g2_prophase (uma classe indicadora, nunca contada como mitótica), prometaphase, metaphase, ana_telo_cyto (anáfase e telófase/citocinese), telophase_daughters (as duas células filhas 2N, uma etapa própria) e artefact. As células em interfase recebem G1, S ou G2 do ajuste do conteúdo de DNA centrado por campo do item 995 (:func:`_dna_phases`). As autoverificações S1-S6 são executadas em cada placa; uma etapa que falha na sua verificação é agrupada na sua categoria superior (:data:`PARENTS`) e marcada como ``unresolved`` em todas as placas da triagem assim que qualquer placa a agrupa. Uma etapa cuja F1 em partições excluídas do treinamento, calculada com os rótulos do usuário, supera o controle com rótulos embaralhados fica ``verified``; todas as outras etapas ficam ``auto``.
